limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The novelty claim is restricted to the exact unit-orbit relative-rank formula, its iterated orbit-weighted extension, and the resulting corrections to Lemmas 3.2 and 3.8 of arXiv:2609.20521v1. The source paper is a recent v1 and may be revised independently. The closest older partition-rank literature was identified, but the full text of the 2009 paper was not text-searchable in the inspected sources, so differently phrased prior coverage remains possible.
record_title: Unit orbits control relative rank in finite monoid wreath products
